bg.$description: Primary button background. Green 700 so the white label reaches 5.0:1 (AA).

text.$description: Secondary / tertiary label and icon (default tone). 5.0:1 on white, 9:1 on the dark surface.
Link button label (default tone), AA in both modes.
Disabled label and icon (exempt from WCAG contrast; kept legible).

bg-hover.$description: Outline social button background on hover.

text.$description: Label of the outline social button.

filled-bg.$description: Filled (black) social button background, e.g. Sign in with Apple.

filled-bg-hover.$description: Filled social button background on hover.

filled-text.$description: Label of the filled social button.

text.$description: Label and icon on hover (default tone).
Warning label, icon and border on secondary, tertiary and link.

text-hover.$description: Warning label, icon and border on hover.

surface-hover.$description: Warning background on hover for non-filled variants.

text.$description: Delete/error label, icon and border on secondary, tertiary, quaternary and link (4.8:1 on white).

text-hover.$description: Delete/error label, icon and border on hover.

surface-hover.$description: Delete/error background on hover for non-filled variants.

bg.$description: Neutral (ghost) filled background, e.g. Cancel in dialogs.

active.$description: Highlighted surface for active/focused drop zones (File input).

muted.$description: Subtle border for secondary input elements (e.g. upload icon container).

error.$description: Placeholder text color when the input is in error state.
Value text color when the input is in error state.

disabled.$description: Helper / supporting text color when the input is disabled.

focused.$description: Icon color when the input is focused.

surface.$description: Background of floating menus (Dropdown) and unselected rows. In Dark it is one step lighter than the page background (gray black/800) so the menu reads as elevated.

selected.$description: Background of the selected menu row.

default.$description: Label of an unselected menu row.

selected.$description: Label of the selected menu row.

default.$description: Leading icon of an unselected menu row.

selected.$description: Leading icon of the selected menu row.

bg.$description: Status chip background over imagery (Collection deck). Same in both modes.

text.$description: Chip label and icon over imagery.

bg-visibility.$description: Visibility chip (PUBLIC / PRIVATE) background over imagery.
